concepts.label: XDCR Advanced Settings
concepts.reused_or_minted: minted - the configuration-settings mechanism (compression, nozzles, checkpoints, batching, network limits) used to fine-tune XDCR performance. First contact for this concept anywhere in the corpus.

concepts.label: XDCR Advanced Filtering
concepts.reused_or_minted: reused - minted in cloud/clusters/xdcr/manage-xdcr-replications.json as 'a filter-expression mechanism for excluding documents from a replication'. This page's 'Advanced Filtering... allows specified subsets of documents to be replicated from the source bucket' is the same mechanism described from the Server reference-manual side.

concepts.label: XDCR Regular Expression
concepts.reused_or_minted: minted - the JavaScript-style regex pattern syntax used inside XDCR filtering-expression pattern-matching functions. First contact.

concepts.label: XDCR Filtering Expression
concepts.reused_or_minted: minted - the SQL++-subset expression language (with additions) used to write XDCR Advanced Filtering match conditions. Distinct from xdcr:replication-filter (the overall feature) and from xdcr:regular-expression (the pattern syntax it embeds via REGEXP_CONTAINS). First contact.

concepts.label: XDCR Data-Type Conversion
concepts.reused_or_minted: minted - the implicit procedure that converts one differently-typed value to another so a filtering-expression comparison or operation can proceed. First contact.

concepts.label: XDCR Collation Comparison
concepts.reused_or_minted: minted - the fallback comparison procedure used when two differently-typed values cannot be converted into a common type; resolved instead by data-type precedence order. First contact.
